mcp_result.command: uv run --project mas_mcp python -c <noninteractive FastMCP probe>

known_validation_notes.note: A PowerShell here-string piped into `uv run --project mas_mcp python -` entered Python 3.14 interactive mode and produced pyrepl console errors. The spawned uv/python processes were stopped, and the MCP probe was rerun successfully with noninteractive `python -c`.

The hook records PowerShell `$?` as success and `$LASTEXITCODE` as exit_code. For one malformed Python probe, exit_code was 1 while success was true. Consumers that need external-process failure semantics should prefer exit_code != 0 over success alone.
